title: Instructing Text-to-Image Generation Models on Fairness
findings: The CLIP encoder, a core component of the Stable Diffusion pipeline, was found to have cultural biases. It associates images representing 'Arab-Muslim' people more strongly with 'unpleasant' concepts compared to 'pleasant' concepts, indicating a significant stereotype.
